about.title: A comprehensive provider of turn-key instrumentation, electrical and analyzer services since 1990.
text: Since 1990, Technical Automation Services has served as a comprehensive provider of turn-key plant instrumentation, electrical and analyzer services. TASC is dedicated to delivering high-quality products and services, ensuring everything is done correctly from the start and consistently thereafter.

Our team is made up of industry leaders who are ready and able to get the job done. At TASC, we take pride in our personnel and invest in their development to nurture the next generation of industry leaders. TASC treats their employees like family, because they are.

TASC is a flexible company that avoids a one-size-fits-all approach. We welcome innovative ideas and solutions to challenges. Since we work with various systems and industries, each operating in unique ways, our strategies must remain adaptable and responsive.
about.imageAlt: Two workers in hard hats reviewing a drawing on site, one wearing a TASC hard hat

values.title: Safety is #1
values.text: Safety is a core value in every service we provide, and a shared responsibility across every team member.

values.title: Flexible by design
values.text: No one-size-fits-all approach; each system and industry works differently, so our strategies stay adaptable.

values.title: Independent integrator
values.text: As an independent provider, TASC can integrate any brand of components and apply best fit technologies.

faqs.q: What industries does TASC work in?
faqs.a: Oil and gas, chemical and petrochemical, power generation and renewables, along with refining, pharmaceutical and water treatment sectors.

faqs.q: Can TASC provide personnel for our site?
faqs.a: Yes. TASC can serve as your onsite contractor with engineers, project managers, planner schedulers, instrumentation technicians, electricians, analyzer technicians, lab technicians and fiber technicians, for short-term or long-term assignments.

faqs.q: Are you tied to a particular analyzer manufacturer?
faqs.a: No. As an independent provider, TASC can integrate any brand of components, and our work with numerous manufacturers lets us apply best fit technologies.

faqs.q: Will TASC travel to our facility?
faqs.a: Yes. Our personnel are available for local, domestic and international travel, as well as on-call support.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a job at TASC?
faqs.a: Send your resume and a TASC employment application to our Human Resources department by email at recruiter@tascorp.com or by fax at 281-474-3211.
